note: agent-decomposed 2026-11-21 (stasis round 2). Draft. The three-step bind ceremony exists (imagodei sign_account_bind_challenge coordinator; doorway user.rs and chaperone.rs reference /auth/node-key/bind; imagodei-portal account-bind route). The release-hosted-apps slice and the graduates-onto-own-key habit (red) remain.

items.text: Step 1: doorway POST /auth/node-key/challenge with session and re-entered password
Step 2: human node signs the challenge (imagodei::sign_account_bind_challenge)
Step 3: doorway POST /auth/node-key/bind verifying signature over the live unspent challenge
Next slice: GET /auth/hosted-apps and POST /auth/hosted-apps/release (NOT_YOURS / IN_USE refusals)
No witnessed lineage linking old key to new; the doorway does not follow the identity head (rotation lands or Matthew rules it out of scope)
External-node routing when the key sits on a conductor the doorway does not pool
Older sessions stay valid until expiry: token_version incremented but no validator checks it
Challenge store has no size cap (pruned of expired entries only); password guesses limited only by the request membrane
Accounts with no declared agency_phase (pre-2026-10-15 rows) are still auto-provisioned
Graduation: graduates-onto-own-key goes green on a household run of auth/graduation/01-onto-my-own-node.feature
